recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If removed ServiceDefinition materials are revived or migrated later, separately review source/servicedefinition/evaluate-operation-request-example.xml for its stale v2-0203 MRN code.
issue_request: FHIR-8382 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for DSTU1 reporting that patient-example.xml used the v2-0203 identifier type code MRN even though Table 0203 uses MR for medical record number.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 5745. Git-svn commit 7db4a5ac4a1f513b5164fb802cfd4fa4b4bb8dc0 is '#8382 - fix up for invalid codes', references build@5745, and changes source/patient/patient-example.xml from MRN to MR while fixing similar invalid example codes.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini and source/patient/list-Patient-examples.xml includes Patient/example. A current-source scan found no v2-0203 MRN match under source/patient. The only whole-source v2-0203 MRN match is in source/servicedefinition/evaluate-operation-request-example.xml, but source/fhir.ini lists ServiceDefinition under [removed-resources] and only a commented note says it was dropped. Patient $merge examples with code MRN use a local hospital code system, not v2-0203.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped Patient source already reflects the requested MR code and the residual out-of-build ServiceDefinition file is not a current FHIR-core Patient fix.
